auth.peer.evidence: transports/local/test/test-local.ps1, measured 2026-09-30 on Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9444: the live pipe's ACL allows only the owning user's SID and denies NETWORK, protected; its label is No-Write-Up and No-Read-Up at Medium, and a low-integrity reader of the same user is denied; it rejects remote clients, and a connect over localhost is refused while an ordinary pipe's is not; the hub refuses a pipe served by a low-integrity process of the same user, and the node refuses a client below its own integrity; a pipe whose ACL denies the caller is refused, and the name stays held between links.

encrypt.evidence: A named pipe on one machine: the bytes never leave it, and nothing encrypts them.

dial.out.evidence: A node-role Open round-trips frames in test/test-transport-conformance.ps1.

dial.in.evidence: A hub-role Open round-trips frames in test/test-transport-conformance.ps1: on one machine the hub dials the node's pipe.

keepalive.evidence: A read is always pending; when the far end closes, it completes with 0 bytes and health reads closed with no frame sent (test/test-transport-conformance.ps1).

survives.peer.restart.evidence: A restarted node is a new pipe instance: the old link reads closed and a new link must be opened (test/test-transport-conformance.ps1).
